These are some photographs I have taken of curb communiqués that have caught
my eye while walking and cycling around Portland. Some are political. Some are
jokes. Some are both. Some I agree with. Some I don’t. Some I can’t make heads
or tails of. But maybe they will resonate with you.

They are free to share and use, as long as you credit: ‘Photograph by
Nathaniel St. Clair, CounterPunch – [CC BY
4.0′](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en)
